{{Quote|Lando Calrissian won the coveted taxi-service license rights for Ord Wylan in a sabacc game, and lost them moments later in an idle bet concerning the brand of a liquor his party was consuming.|A news report by [[Cynabar's InfoNet]]|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Oktos sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It formed a part of the Mid Rim's border with [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The sector contained the [[Dakaret system/Legends|Dakaret]], [[Mhalanduin system/Legends|Mhalanduin]], [[Nirellia system/Legends|Nirellia]], [[Ord Wylan system/Legends|Ord Wylan]], and [[Ruloosia system/Legends|Ruloosia systems]]. The [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] also passed through the sector. A pair of [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the Oktos sector was the [[Nirellian ground-slug]] and the [[Ruloosian sand-snake]].

By [[0 ABY/Legends|36:1:16]], the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] briefly owned the license rights for a [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]]-service on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Wylan]] after winning them in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] advanced along the stretch of the Gamor Run passing through the Oktos sector before [[Battle of the Lannik system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacking]] the [[Lannik system/Legends|Lannik system]] in the neighboring [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] later sent a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] along that section of the Gamor Run to aid their allies in the [[Confederation]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Description==
===Location and star systems===
The Oktos [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]] [[spinward]] and the [[Hune sector/Legends|Hune]] and [[Daalang sector/Legends|Daalang sectors]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] The sector also shared the [[trailing]] border with [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]] and formed the Mid Rim's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border with [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The northwestern section of<ref name="Directions">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Oktos [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] of [[Nirellia system/Legends|Nirellia]] in grid square Q-11, [[Dakaret system/Legends|Dakaret]] in square Q-12, and [[Mhalanduin system/Legends|Mhalanduin]], [[Ruloosia system/Legends|Ruloosia]], and [[Ord Wylan system/Legends|Ord Wylan]] in square R-12, which corresponds to the northwestern, western, and southeastern section of the sector, respectively, according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}.</ref> the Oktos sector contained the [[Nirellia system/Legends|Nirellia system]]. The [[Dakaret system/Legends|Dakaret system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was situated in the western portion of the sector, and the southeastern section of<ref name="Directions" /> the Oktos sector contained the [[Mhalanduin system/Legends|Mhalanduin]], [[Ruloosia system/Legends|Ruloosia]], and [[Ord Wylan system/Legends|Ord Wylan systems]].<ref name="EAOC" />

===Routes and namesakes===
[[File:Oktos-TEA.png|thumb|right|220px|The Oktos sector lay on the Mid Rim's border with Hutt Space and shared its name with the Oktos Nebula.]]
The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]]<ref name="Gamor" /> passed through the southernmost portion of the Oktos sector close to its border with Lannik Space. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked the sector to the [[Daalang system/Legends|Daalang system]] in the eponymous sector<ref name="Mid Rim" /> as well as the [[Circumtore system/Legends|Circumtore system]] in Hutt Space.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Oktos sector shared its name with the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]], a Hutt Space [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]] located close to that region's border with the Mid Rim; the [[Oktos Route]], a hyperlane traveling along the edges of the Oktos Nebula before entering the Mid Rim;<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Oktos Zone Imperial Outpost]], a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] facility on the Hutt Space planet [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydaria]].<ref name="Lords">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

==History==
After [[Attack on the Circumtore system|conquering]] the Circumtore [[Star system/Legends|system]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] advanced along the Gamor Run toward the previously-captured Daalang system before traveling along the [[Bothan Run/Legends|Bothan Run]] hyperlane in order to [[Battle of the Lannik system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] the [[Lannik system/Legends|Lannik system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in Lannik Space.<ref name="EAOC" />

When the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] broke out in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] sent a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to aid the [[Confederation]] in its fight against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the Coreward regions of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The fleet, originating from the Hutt Space planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], traveled along the section of the Gamor Run connecting the Circumtore and Daalang systems before transferring to the route known as the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
[[File:OrdWylan-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Oktos sector world Ord Wylan served as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot during the Pius Dea Era.]]
The Nirellia system was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Nirellian ground-slug]]s.<ref name="Mandalorian Armor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> The Dakaret system shared its name with the [[Holovid/Legends|holo-vid]] ''[[Denizens of Dakaret IX]]'',<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> while the name of the Mhalanduin system was shared by the [[Mhalanduin Reformation]],<ref name="Author">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}}</ref> an event that occurred at some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}} establishes that [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] was alive by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Mhalanduin Reformation]] took place. Furthermore, the novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] places Motti aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] during its [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Therefore, the Mhalanduin Reformation must have occurred by that date.</ref> The Ruloosia system was home to [[Ruloosian sand-snake]]s,<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="SWC11" /> and the Ord Wylan system contained a [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Ord Wylan|same name]].<ref name="GNN" />

Ord Wylan served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], despite it being located just outside the borders of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> by the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 36:1:16, the license rights for a [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]] service on Ord Wylan had become highly sought-after. During that time, the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] won the rights in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], although he lost them only moments later in a bet over the brand of [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] the players were [[Foodstuff/Legends|drinking]].<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oktos sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', confirmed on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that the sector was named after the Oktos Nebula.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618822|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:56 PM|quote=Yes, Oktos Sector is named for the nebula.}}</ref> In [[2012]], the Oktos sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature [https://web.archive.org/web/20170713024921/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim], which placed it in grid squares Q-11, Q-12, P-11, and P-12.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
